intent: Return and call to action in the lifelike 3D finale: Renee, rested and steady, with the book; the upper third stays clean for the exact title, offer and link added in post.
subject: The client's hardcover book standing upright on a sunlit wooden side table in the lower third of the frame, front cover facing the camera, spine on the left. Renee stands behind and slightly to screen-right of the book, softly out of focus, chest-up, holding a mug in both hands. The mug is plain matte terracotta with no print.
composition: Lower third: the book, sharp, centred. Middle third: Renee, soft focus, at screen-right, looking at the book. Upper third: a clean, evenly lit wall of warm cream plaster with no objects, reserved for overlay text. Screen-left: a window frame edge with sheer curtains glowing in late sun.
negative_space: The upper third of the frame stays empty, smooth and evenly lit for the overlay text.

action.start: The clip opens on the first frame: the book upright, Renee behind it looking down at it with a calm face.
action.end: Renee lifts her eyes from the book to the lens, her chin rising slightly, and a small, real smile forms at the corners of her mouth and in her eyes; her hands stay around the mug and the book stays perfectly still and sharp.
action.direction: Only Renee moves: her head rises about ten degrees toward the lens and does not turn. The book does not move, tilt or rotate at any point.

camera.plain: The camera pushes in very slowly toward the book, about ten percent closer by the end, keeping the book centred and the upper third clear.

lens_light: Virtual cinema lens equivalent to 50 mm, focus held on the book cover with Renee in soft focus behind it. Golden late-afternoon sun from the screen-left window is the key, laying a warm amber stripe across the table and the book's front cover and a soft golden rim on Renee's hair and shoulders. Gentle bounce from the cream wall fills the shadows. The cover stays evenly lit so no part of it falls into shadow.
visible_emotion: rested joy and quiet pride (payoff line; a smile is allowed)
motion_physics: Steam rises slowly from the mug and curls toward screen-right in the warm air. The sheer curtain at screen-left drifts once in a light breeze. Renee breathes calmly; the cardigan rises and falls softly. Dust motes float in the sunbeam above the table, few and slow. Her glasses catch one soft glint of sun as her head rises.
beats: Still frame on the book; Renee looks down at it while steam curls slowly up from the mug.
Renee lifts her eyes toward the lens, her chin rising slightly.
A small, real smile reaches her eyes; the sheer curtain drifts once; the whole composition holds still for the overlay text.
